notes: Switzerland: clinic data re-checked 2026-11-04 on the clinics' own pages or official pages; entries that could only be confirmed on directory pages were removed. No cantonal vet-society rotas for Zürich/Bern clinics beyond the services listed. Tox Info Suisse (145) is a human poison centre; its page does not say pets are covered. Premium-rate 0900 emergency lines are included as published. Not covered: Valais/Wallis, Neuchâtel, Jura, Schaffhausen, Aargau, Winterthur, Davos, St. Moritz.
